properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Multiple parts of Gatsby use Node.js HTTPS clients with default settings, which permits Diffie-Hellman key exchange with 2048-bit primes. This allows for harvesting of TLS sessions that could be decrypted once quantum computers become powerful enough.
